title: Merge manager
description: The agent session that holds the merge-steward lane on one or more repositories and runs its watch loop (`merge-manager-watcher`, Process_MergeManagerWatch): it wakes on a timer, on PR events, when a main run finishes, or on a sibling's message; it reads the open PRs, the runner queue, main's verdict and the PR owners live; and it routes each reading to the merge train, a saturation meta-merge, or a stalled-agent takeover. One live session holds the lane per repository while the lane is needed, and announces `merge manager: <session id>` to every sibling and the owner when it takes the lane, and to whom when it hands it over. When none is active the siblings elect one (the owner of the P0 PR, else the earliest-created active session), and a lone session is its own merge manager. Siblings send it a six-line merge request (PR and head SHA, session URL, explanation, rendered preview, what to look for, full tier green as judged), which it posts in its chat before asking the owner by card. It acknowledges each request within about 10 minutes and posts a heartbeat with each sweep (every 10-15 minutes while a P0 is in flight, 30 otherwise); like any agent it may stall, and a sibling whose request goes unacknowledged for about 30 minutes, or whose merge manager's session is inactive, re-elects without it. It merges only on the owner's explicit OK, given in its own session as one card per batch, holds and releases the swarm around every batch landing, and reports what landed and main's verdict.
